course_credit_form.name: course_credit_form
course_credit_form.value:
("course"."credits_hundredths" IS NOT NULL AND "course"."min_credits_hundredths" IS NULL AND "course"."max_credits_hundredths" IS NULL)
        OR ("course"."credits_hundredths" IS NULL AND "course"."min_credits_hundredths" IS NOT NULL AND "course"."max_credits_hundredths" IS NOT NULL)

course_credit_range.name: course_credit_range
course_credit_range.value:
"course"."min_credits_hundredths" IS NULL OR "course"."max_credits_hundredths" IS NULL
        OR "course"."min_credits_hundredths" <= "course"."max_credits_hundredths"
